method: Text is read in one pass from left to right. An escape sequence starts at a real ESC character (U+001B), at the single-byte C1 introducers U+009B and U+009D, or, while the written-forms option is on, at the text \x1b, \u001b, \033, \e or ^[, which are treated as an ESC character; a written form only counts when the character after it begins a sequence ([, ], P, X, ^, _, a character-set designator such as ( or #, or one of the two-letter finals), so a Windows path like C:\example stays text. After ESC, [ opens a control sequence: an optional private prefix (? < = >), numeric parameters and colons, optional intermediate bytes 0x20-0x2F, then a final byte 0x40-0x7E. A control sequence that runs out of text before its final byte, and an operating system command or device control string with no BEL or string terminator within 512 characters, is reported as incomplete rather than guessed. Control sequences ending in m are styling (SGR) and are applied to a running style state: 0 resets, 1 bold, 2 dim, 3 italic, 4 and 21 underline, 5 blink, 7 reverse, 8 hidden, 9 strike-through, 22-29 turn those off, 30-37 and 90-97 set the foreground, 40-47 and 100-107 the background, 39 and 49 restore the defaults, and 38/48 select an indexed or 24-bit colour in the semicolon form (38;5;n, 38;2;r;g;b) or the colon form (38:5:n, 38:2::r:g:b). Indexed colours 0-15 are the system colours on the usual VGA palette, 16-231 the 6x6x6 cube built from the levels 0, 95, 135, 175, 215 and 255, and 232-255 greys from 8 in steps of 10, so index 196 is #ff0000 and index 17 is #00005f. Every other sequence keeps its parameters and gains a plain-English meaning: cursor movement, erase, insert and delete, scrolling region, DEC private modes such as 25 cursor visibility, 1049 alternate screen and 2004 bracketed paste, cursor style, character-set selection, operating system commands (window title, hyperlink, palette, clipboard, shell integration) and device control strings. The preview applies colour and attributes only: cursor movement, scrolling and erasing are described but not emulated, so a progress bar redrawn with a carriage return appears as one line. Line feed and tab are kept as text; other control characters are counted, listed and drawn as their U+2400 control pictures. Positions are one-based line and column in the original paste. Limits: the paste may hold up to 20000 characters, 400 sequences are listed while the counts cover the whole paste, and nothing is stored, uploaded, fetched or evaluated in the browser.

sources.title: ESC [ begins a control sequence whose parameter bytes are 0x30-0x3F, intermediate bytes 0x20-0x2F and final byte 0x40-0x7E.
SGR is the control sequence ending in m; parameters 0-9, 21-29, 30-37, 39, 40-47, 49 and 90-107 set attributes and colours, and 38/48 select indexed or 24-bit colour.
An operating system command is introduced by ESC ] and ended by BEL or the string terminator ESC backslash; a device control string is introduced by ESC P.
A two-character escape sequence is ESC followed by one final character, such as ESC c for a full reset or ESC M for a reverse index.
Indexed colour 16-231 is a 6x6x6 cube of the values 0, 95, 135, 175, 215 and 255, and 232-255 are greys from 8 in steps of 10.
